relationships.subject: Dillenia indica hydroethanolic extract
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that DI-HET is effective against NAFLD by activation of the SIRT-1/p-LKB-1/AMPK signaling pathway via polyphenols present in the extract.

key_findings: DI-HET reduced oleic acid-induced lipid accumulation in HepG2 cells and upregulated SIRT-1, p-LKB-1, p-AMPK, p-ACC, CPT-1 and PPAR-alpha.
Off-topic for pain themes (ACC here is acetyl-CoA carboxylase).
